expectations.text: Uses Keep a Changelog format with ## [2.4.0] heading and date
Groups bug fixes under ### Fixed section

expectations.evidence: All 5: OAuth2 (Authentication), CSV export (Reporting), Dark mode (UI), WebSocket memory leak, Scheduler timezone fix.
Bold category prefixes, user-impact descriptions: 'enabling offline analysis and data portability', 'caused jobs to fire at wrong times in non-UTC zones'.
Lines 20-23: '[Unreleased]: .../compare/v2.4.0...HEAD' and '[2.4.0]: .../compare/v2.3.0...v2.4.0'. Agent quotes skill's 'most commonly forgotten element' guidance.
